topics.topic: Federated learning privacy attacks on edge devices
topics.review_note: Papers covering gradient inversion attacks, differential privacy defenses, and resource-constrained FL deployment on edge devices.

paper_relevance.title: iDLG: Improved Deep Leakage from Gradients
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Improved DLG — tìm ground-truth labels xác định từ shared gradients trong FL. Directly addresses gradient inversion theme.

paper_relevance.title: Deep Leakage from Gradients (DLG)
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Seminal DLG paper — proof-of-concept rằng private training data có thể được reconstruct từ gradients. Foundational cho gradient inversion research.

paper_relevance.title: R-GAP: Recursive Gradient Attack on Privacy
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: R-GAP — recursive gradient attack có thể reconstruct data từ gradients chính xác hơn DLG. Advances gradient inversion attacks.

paper_relevance.title: Gradient Inversion with Generative Image Prior
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Dùng generative image prior để cải thiện gradient inversion attack — reconstructs high-quality images từ gradients trong FL.

paper_relevance.title: Privacy Attacks in Federated Learning: A Survey
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Survey toàn diện về privacy attacks trong FL: gradient inversion, membership inference, model inversion. Covers cả attacks và defenses.

paper_relevance.title: PPFL: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Edge Devices
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Privacy-preserving FL specifically designed for edge devices — addresses resource-constrained deployment và differential privacy tradeoffs.

paper_relevance.title: SCAFFOLD: Stochastic Controlled Averaging for Federated Learning
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: SCAFFOLD giải quyết client drift trong FL với non-IID data — critical cho edge deployment với heterogeneous devices.

paper_relevance.title: Soteria: Provable Defense Against Privacy Leakage in Federated Learning from Representation Perspective
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Soteria — defense mechanism chống gradient inversion attacks, perturbation của data representations. Directly relevant cho attacks/defenses theme.

paper_relevance.title: PATE-FL: Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning via PATE
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: PATE framework adapted for FL — combines teacher ensemble with DP for edge-device deployment. Addresses differential privacy theme.

paper_relevance.title: Survey on Federated Learning Threats: Concepts, Taxonomy, and Defenses
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Taxonomy of FL threats covering gradient inversion, model poisoning, membership inference — comprehensive overview of attack surface.

paper_relevance.title: GradInversion: Recovering Private Training Data from Gradients with High Fidelity
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: GradInversion — high-fidelity image reconstruction from batch gradients in FL. Regularization + BN statistics-based attack. Strongest gradient inversion result on ImageNet.

paper_relevance.title: Inverting Gradients: How Easy is it to Break Privacy in Federated Learning?
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Cosine similarity-based gradient inversion — reconstructs high-resolution images from single-sample and batch gradients. Shows privacy risk in large-scale FL.

paper_relevance.title: The Fundamental Price of Secure Aggregation in Differentially Private Federated Learning
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Theoretical analysis of the privacy-utility-communication tradeoff in DP-FL with secure aggregation — fundamental limits for edge device deployment.

paper_relevance.title: Membership Inference Attacks Against Machine Learning Models in Federated Learning
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Membership inference attacks in FL — determines whether a sample was in a client's training set from model updates. Complementary privacy threat to gradient inversion.

paper_relevance.title: FLASH: Federated Learning with Asynchronous and Sparse Hybrid Updates for Privacy
paper_relevance.relevance_reason: Asynchronous FL with sparse updates for edge devices — addresses communication efficiency and privacy on resource-constrained IoT/mobile devices.

topics.reference_answer: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, but gradient sharing introduces privacy risks. Three main attack vectors: (1) Gradient inversion: DLG (Zhu et al. 2019) demonstrated private data reconstruction from gradients; iDLG and R-GAP improved accuracy; generative prior-based attacks further reduce reconstruction error. (2) Differential privacy defenses: DP-SGD adds calibrated noise to gradients before sharing; PATE-FL adapts teacher-student DP to FL; Soteria perturbs representations to resist inversion. (3) Resource-constrained edge deployment: SCAFFOLD addresses client drift on heterogeneous edge devices; communication compression creates additional attack surface. Key tradeoff: stronger privacy guarantees (lower ε in DP) degrade model utility, especially on edge devices with limited compute.
